entry.title: Playing AI Limit Part 1
entry.content:
First few hours early thoughts

So the game is a soulslike, except with cute anime girls. Honestly I was hoping for an game that is easy on the eyes and execute it well. The necros are some biological monsters attacking everyone as well as bandits. For the game itself I have went through a few bosses, the combat is simple to understand and quite easy to learn. There is no stamina management but each attack needs to be commited. Anyone who have played Dark Souls game will find themself famillar here. While I don’t think the game is breaking any new ground or introducing the next revolution to the soulslike genre, it does what already exist well.

The main mechanics introduced is essentially quite similar to stability, it is a bar that goes up if you attack enemies and goes down if you are hit or you use skills. A benefit of this is that it becomes more feasible to spam the “magic” spells, which I was always reluctant to do in most soulslike as I might run out before needing them.

Story?

Now the game is explictly named AI Limits, but so far I haven’t find out why is it named as such. Maybe it is a spoiler. But the story is really cryptic so far, to be honest I have no idea what is going on, just like the protagonist who is anmestic. Of the NPC I think Feylia was the most memorable simply because of how big her sword was and was taller than her. The others are crpytic just like soul’s npc.

Customization!

I am glad that they did not go with the gritty serious tone compared to the rest, I was able to put the main character in some funny outfits. The above is an rabbit outfit and it looks ridicious along with the scythe. Here is to hoping to more funny outfit, I will be switching outfit with every post I put out there.

Thoughts on the first few locations

So I think I went through the starting area, which is mostly sewers, a desert town, sewers and more sewers. When I left off I am at some woods. Now obviously the fist few location arent exactly expected to be awe inspiring, but I felt they suceed a bit. At the desert town we see the church walls and I am instantly curious what is inside the walls. Inside the walls there are some random floating stuff. Through the main objective is to collect branches that literally nobody knows why they are doing. I think all the bladers(the term used to refer to our character) have found a new hobby in the meantime.

The enemies so far are rather generic, so nothing to say here. And so are the bosses. But hey they serve a purpose to get me used to the game. I am getting better at the parrying as well. I was able to learn how to parry most of them, even if they aren’t exactly memorable.

Going foward this is what I am expecting: At least one duel boss that uses a simillar moveset instead of wild beast At least one awe inspiring location that screams beauty An explaination of what the hell is going on.

Until the next time

entry.title: I played:Sifu(Loop)
entry.content:
Storytelling

The evil pupil and his 5 associate killed your master, who is also your father. So go and kill them. The premise is extremely simple to understand. Which is fine as it isnt the focus anyways. So lets get into the focus which is the gameplay

Gameplay

Stage design

The game has some gogerous design, all 5 locations have a color schemes and themes making them distinct, on top of that all the mooks involved are also dressed differently. Even through the core concepts are the same, the dialogue is able to make everyone feel different, from the slurring among the initial druggies, to the professional bodyguards hunting down the player later. The visuals are outsanding making use of camera angles, such as the replication of the corridor fighting in the first stage, or the second stage with a narration of rain.

Many stages also have shortcuts later on, allowing you to skip past the stage to fight the bosses. I like the dilemna here as it is possible to clear stages using the shortcut to avoid potential death, however it means not being able to access upgrades at certain part of the stage. It ensures that later on it doesnt become skip the entire stage and fight the boss.

Difficulity

Overall I felt that the game difficulity curves relatively well. The game starts off with druggies who comes in group but uses big telegraph attacks, then it moves on to introduce special enemies, finally it combine the special enemies as one. It uses an aging system that acts as the time limit of how many times you can die and generously save the lowest age. This incentives me to try to clear previous stages with less deaths so I can die more in the later stages when the difficulity rises, however this also makes the player better at the game and improving their skills later on.

Enemy and boss design

For the game duration I am really happy to say that all the bosses feel distinct. Even if I feel that the bosses difficulity is not that well balanced. In my playthrough, I will rank the bosses difficulity as 5th Boss>3rd Boss»4th Boss»1st Boss>2nd boss

To cover each, the first boss uses relatively basic attacks, with some bladed attack mixed in at phase 2. Whereas the second boss essentially act as a more advanced version of all the mini bosses that the player likely fought in the entire stage. The third stage new enemy type does not feel related to the boss. I think she has some very long attack chains, as well as a mix of lower and upper swipe attacks. Suprising her second phase is easier than the first becaue her attack chain becomes easier to read. The fourth boss uses long range attacks however she is relatively fragile, I was able to beat her.

The fifth boss, in my opinion, strictly enforce a single playstyle that is contary to how the mooks teaches the game. For both the first and third boss, the bladed weapons encourages doding instead since missing a parry means either blocking and taking chip damage, or taking damage. In the regular game group fights, parrying isn’t the best because most of the time there is too much shit going on to focus on one enemy. The fifth boss is much easier using parrying compared to everything else.

Conclusion

I really enjoyed my time with this game, because it taught me patience and a variety of playstyle. It is a game that truely rewards skills over all else, and everything is in service of the gameplay which I am glad to say feels good to play.

entry.title: I played:007 First Light
entry.content:
4 Sentence Summary

The story feels like a modern day James Bond movie. It taps into some of the anxiety of 2026 however felt rushed at the end.

The game is a linear action/stealth game, with semi open world segments.

The difficulity of the game is low, with little variation in comabt or skill involved.

I finished the main story on normal difficulity in 16.5 hours.

Storytelling - James Bond Origin

The story that is told is basically that of IOI own take on James Bond, the famous spy. The story is servicible, with a strong start that falls off midway through. It tapes into the theme in 2026(which is AI) and the villian motive is compelling, at the end they are clearly setting up a sequence hook. However the final segment felt very rushed.

Gameplay - A bit of stealth,action and very little driving

Stealth

Stealth is what Bond is known for, on top of gadgets to distract potential watchers, Bond is also able to activate distractions. He also has the ability to lure enemies or bluff them, in pracitce I rarely remember ot use these.

There are two type of stealth here Social Stealth-For these type it is not possible to turn to combat,it usually occur in the public and if caught Bond just teleports away. Usually for these there are a few solutions which all lead to the same outcome. Combat Stealth-These are more traditional stealth experience as the player try to finish some objective without getting seen. It is reasonably well implemented and the bluffing ability makes it possible to get away with non perfect play. Both of them ensure that the game never get stale during stealth sections as the game swithces between both as we go from a social camoflague to sneaking around high security

Combat

Melee combat is what you turn to if stealth fails, there is a parry and a dodge. James Bond also has an grab he can use as well as certain envriomental objects. It start off strong however Bond never gets any new moves, and the enemy types are limited. So combat becomes boring after a while.

In terms of the shooter element, it is a fairy generic shooting game. One notable thing is that James Bond never carries a lot of ammo, making it necessary to switch weapons.

Misc

The driving segment is really handholded, if you are able to inconvenient some poor pedestrian the car will auto steer out of their way. Except for a chase near the start, driving never felt exciting as the path is always linear with no possibility of failure.

The bosses are a dissapointment and does not take advantage of the game system fully. Only the first boss fight at the basement make use of Bond hacking tool extensively, after that the fights fall off into overly gimmick fight. I don’t feel like a spy outsmarting the opponenet, I feel like John fucking Wick shooting a continental solider, where unless you fufill its gimmick it does nothing.

To discuss the dialogue options I am pretty confident there is 0 variation in what happens. It does not matter what Bond reply things turn out the same. There is only a single moment where you can fail if you didn’t choose correctly. It really puts a dent in the mode knowing the dialogue choices does not matter.

Finally I must talk about this, there is a ridicious amount of handholding. I don’t need my mission control to tell me to check out X where X is always the solution. I was trying to solve a puzzle to get past a door and my partner just shows up and tell me to get over. Is it that bad to struggle on a puzzle? If I cannot figure it out let me google it, not have the NPC point it out.

Non Spoiler summary

I felt that the story is the only reason to play the game, if a James Bond style story isn’t for you it is a safe skip. The gameplay is not strong enough to justify the time spent. Tac Sim mode seems promising…but it is quite barebones at the moment.

Spoiler Discussion

Personally I felt that the game has a very strong start, it starts strong esclating as Bond goes from a regular solider to getting recruited then to the mission in Solvakia. The car chase feel straight out of a Bond Movie, taking shortcuts to catch up and ending in a badass segement where we get to control the tilt of the plane to get through the baddies. At this point the Solvakia mission has a few options, from burning a bin to swiping an employee key card.

Railroading

After the above mission, we get to go to a pirates market. There are several activites possible here, in a full exploration where you need to earn money for the auction. I did the boxing ring, and the art deal. Once I get my goal ALL activies instantly become unavailable. I wanted to do the cup game, or the phone hacking, or the shooting range, the game disagree and think I should go back to Greenway.

On top of that with exactly one exception, the dialogue options do not matter. You know in Casino Royale where Bond won with trickery and insight? I don’t feel like bond when none of my options matter. The only part this is implemented is taunting Damien to get him close so we can hack his phone, this is the only smart part. Meanwhile when we have a contact that is blown, or when we are about to be lowered to aligators, regardless what I cannot lose. It takes the tension out.

Repetitive gameplay

The formula of the game is essentially doing social stealth,then regular stealth, and ending with a shoot out. The enemy does not actually change, the enemies early on down at the laundary bay feel exactly the same as the guards in the preultimate area. The guns can be summarized as pistol, shotgun,assault rifle, submachine gun and a sniper rifle, with supressed variants. The enemy type can be summarized as normal and armored guys. All in all I felt like I was doing the exact same thing in a loop. Also the sheer amount of walking or following a character isn’t helping , just make it a cutscene if I cannot deviate from the path.

Lackluster bosses

The only boss fight is the fight against Monroe. Literally the first fight, it is a cool CQC fight spanning across multiple locations. A strong start, however all other bosses aren’t that unique. Tero Murto requires the usage of traps to damage him, however it just ends after 3 hits. The subsequent CQC is completely cut scene based. Meanwhile the other Murto twin is a standard CQC fight in the same building, yes it get set on fire later on but the boss himself is unchanged. The fight against Damien is extremely simillar to Tero Murto,where it is completely dependent on the surroundings. The final boss. have a phase 1 which involves the same thing as Tero, while a phase 2 that is basically the Anor Londo archers. It takes place…in the sewers. So the visual sucks, and it is not intersting or difficult. The story should have ended after antartica, not only do the final boss NOT use melee combat which the game does well in, it is barely a fight.

Conclusions

Overall this game is not my thing, it felt tailored made to the most casual of audiences. It is definetly not worth the almost 70$ price tag. The Tac Sim seems to be the intended post game but it is really underbaked. After a year or so maybe it will be worth the price.

entry.title: Toastmaster NEW TERM
entry.content:
After a year of being Club President, it is finally over.

Club President Bryan

This was a most challanging journey, I was extremely reluctant to take up the role as I am aware I will be away from August to January. However, the circumstances forced me into it. This is how I became the club president.

Managing the club overseas

While in Spain, I continue to hold exco meeting with my club. I am glad to have some reliable lads who are able to update me on the suitation. However, my lack of physical presence is indeed an issue. During this period we are able to hold the club in stagnation, ensuring it stays as per usual. I took the role to try to mentor the Vice President of Education…but he just dipped on me halfway. I also took the role to contact people and ensure the club program sheet is well planned so the people on the ground have an easier job.

#Managing the club over here

When I return in January, the first massive issue is that the club home grounds is closed for rennovation. I had to come up with some creative solutions in order to maintain things. The first time we did was zoom meetings, however I made a crucial mistake and delayed the January meeting as there is a lack of people interested. This mistake resulted in the momentum of the club halting, and I had to work hard by talking to people, coming up with intresting themes in order to revive the momentum.

For several months we will continue online meetings, the limitation of online meetings make engagement challanging.

entry.title: Reading: Hoshi Ori Yume Mirai - Common Route

link.title: Reading: Hoshi Ori Yume Mirai - Common Route

entry.content:
Background

It has dawn about me that I have forgotten the common route that connects all the paths, so I thought I should cover it first.

General Thoughts

I will first talk about the first half which is introducing everyone, and the second half which is used to establish the story.

One of the most suprising part is that the protagonist,Ryosuke Hino…has hope and dreams. I know very high bar to clear, however the sheer amount that is just a nice guy blank slate or a backstory that serve to justify them being overpowered means that this actually make the protagonist intresting. We see the POV character is interested in Architecture, and this actually drives some of his actions later on. Most importantly, this means that I can actually see myself falling for him.

Afterwards we are introduced to the characters basically in this order,i think.

Sora Ousaka is the shy, quiet lass who love astrology.

Natsuki Segawa is a energetic lass who love photography.

Azuma Morio is a figure of admiration and mature despite being airheaded.

Marika Shinozaki is the sweet childhood friend who recovered from an illness.

Nirasawa Shuuichi who is the a childhood friend with a friendly fierce competitive streak with the protagonist.

Rikka Narusawa is cold and stoic while being good at the piano.

Misa Okihara is a knowledgable and sisterly lass about marine life.

Touko Yukimura who is a bit of a rebel.

I felt that the introductions did a good job at establishing who everyone is and the type of interest and personality they have. So I have no issue with the first segment at all.

For the second segment we are introduced to the Tanabata festival, and the town unique celeberation. This set up the core driving force for most of the actions taken in the school segment.

For this segment I felt that it was allright, it did its job to make the introduced character into a group. Narusawa-san is the only one that felt like she is literally dragged there by the party. This segment was not the most intresting since they still include more information for every character, and at this point I felt like the elaboration isn’t really necessary. This entire segment is basically the “checkbox” to decide whose route you are romancing.

My biggest issue is that the choices does not feel like they matter. Early on Shinozaki-san has a choice to wait for her or go home, regardless of what you choose you still wait for her. It is probably used to count which part to put the player on but why not just…skip it. As a result I wasn’t aware that these choices affect who we are pursuing later(since they outcome is exactly the same). I think it will be fine to skip it, so if we don’t wait for Marika we skip the entire segment, which makes more sense into the romance part since well we spend less time with her.

The group scenes however are great, and the conversation at the end paints a good picture of what to expect from each girl when pursuing them. All the silly games they play does help in creating the atmosphere.

Summary for the common route

I like the establishment of all the characters, as well as the story. I will appericate if the game is not in fear that I will miss their brilliant writing.

Sora Route

Natsuki Route

entry.title: Reading: Hoshi Ori Yume Mirai - Natuuki Route

link.title: Reading: Hoshi Ori Yume Mirai - Natuuki Route

entry.content:
Background

The reason I decide to attempt to romance her is simply because she is the most prominent of all the love interest in Ousaka-san path. From aiding in the love confession to showing up in the after story.

General Thoughts - School Arc

Segawa-san School Arc difference is that she basically dragged the protagonist along and they eventurally developed feelings. Her primary theme is photography. Her route is devoid of any major conflict and basically sees the protagonist keeping up with her as she take photos for the club. Notably what the astrology and nature club end up doing both end up changing to make her a major player.

The love confession felt kinda abrupt. After spending enough time with each other, they realize they like one another. Or at least the protagonist seems to think so, however his obviliousness doesnt exactly convince me so. It does make use of photography that I find was neat,and is a very Segawa way of confessing.

It primary focus on her obession with photography and the various things they did. The ending felt a little abrupt as they went to the festival and it ends…just like that I am a little sad that the group trip they were talking about just didn’t happen. It might be better if that was never mentioned since I was expecting, you know that group trip to be the climax of the story.

General Thoughts - After Story

Natsuki(From here on) After Story place a heavy focus on the post marriage life, with a heavy emphasis on the ideal post marriage life. It is a very fluffy read and seems to cover the honeymoon period. The ending fits Natsuki Hino quite well and is photography relevant. They have their rituals, the people around them treating them after the marriage, and how they perform the chores and cook together when they are living as a couple.The story ends with the actual ceremony for the marriage conducted by the school

General Thoughts - The Sex Scene

She has around 9 scenes I believe, and somehow all of them are plot relevant as for a lack of a better words showing them fucking raw with zero damn about the world leading to their shotgun marriage is pherhaps the most realistic part about fucking like rabbits. Even if they discover they have no child it is highly belivable. The most plot relevant one is when they are both late due to fucking deep at night. The rest is passable by explaining how they can believe in the pregency.

General Thoughts - Overall

Segawa route is rather unique due to her airheadness, and unique personality. It is a fluffy story that somehow doesn’t stick in my mind. I am optimistic that she might not be my type.

entry.title: Settler Frontier, Coding Workshop
entry.content:
This is the poster of the event.

The initial motivation for doing the workshop is simply to test the water if more technical workshop can do well in the community. As someone who has gotten interested in software, I have went through a module on computational thinking. After witnessing my classmate solution which involves several hundred primitive statement to get things done, I reazlie that it is not as intutive as I thought

Play Frontier Explorer

The game is designed with programming background in mind, it involves a maze where they have to navigate. I was able to make use of AI to convert my python syntax and logic into javascript, the primary challange is to figure out how to structure the syntax such that it is easier to expand. Overall I made the choice to make it convert into a python script in the back. It is intentionally coded such that it is possible for both semantic error and syntax error to occur, just like real programming.

Using my experience from modding Stellaris, I decide I do not want to write code in order to add more stages. As a result I make it read a JSON file outside, so I can add stages easier.

Additioanlly the instructions are read naturally then moved by some relatively else if logic.

I tried my hand at another game, that actually uses Settler Frontier theme accurately which involve the player actually going around and trying to survvie. Unfortuatnely I was unable to finish it on time. You can check it out below.

Play Settler Frontier

entry.title: Reading: Hoshi Ori Yume Mirai - Sora Route

link.title: Reading: Hoshi Ori Yume Mirai - Sora Route

entry.content:
General Thoughts - School Arc

So in this route we are basically stuck with Sora and assisting with the astrology club, who become talkative when it is about the stars. Notably Sora does demonstrate some intresting knowledge about astrology and the associated mythology. There are some light drama and issues they faced which are solved almost immeditely, however the brief moment of setback are realsitic and truely feel like life and dead for that age.

The love confession and realization has quite a bit of build up, from when our protagonist realizes his feelings, to learning more about her then finally confessing at a chance. Notably the protagonist does not actually get a reply immedietly and has to wait for her response. They continue per normal until she resond in affimartive. The group of friends meanwhile play a supporting role offsetting Sora shy nature, and continue to play a role through the festival contribution.

The next part can be broken down into two segment, but generally they face some problem and overcome them. The best way to describe it is that everyone work hard and it eventurally worked out. It felt like they really cared for each other. Notably I was actually suprised at the third setback(since it has been so drama light). The finale felt like a suitable conclusion as we see their hard work pay off and Sora dream is realized.

General Thoughts - After Story

Whereas the school arc mainly focus on realizing Sora dream, there is a notably swap here where the protagonist take center stage as he open his own firm with Sora and best boss Azuma supporting him. Sora at this point already mostly accomplished her goals in astrology which the protagonist get to witness, the protagonist meanwhile face some struggles maintaining his work life. My favorite scene is when the protagonist faints from overwork, and immeditely continue trying to work again until Sora propose to him. Where the terms she proposal shows she is willing to give up her own dream just to support him,causing the protagonist to realize how he has screwed up and take action to correct.. Eventurally he was able to fufill his own dreams, and then he finally marry Sora and gaze the stars together. The post credit scene confirms that Sora dreams is well and alive after the marriage as he and the other friends arrive to support Sora.

General Thoughts - The Sex Scene

She has around 10 scene I believe, and most of the scene felt extremely simillar. Basically I think the plot relevant ones are probably exactly 2. The first is used to show her more assertive side, and the second is used to show how she is willing to accept his fetishes as a part of him. Some of them does depict her as being more careful, however the usage of condom dies after the first raw experience so I am not sure if the above was intended.

General Thoughts - Overall

This is a strong introduction to the novel, I like that it is relatively low stakes and used to further the characters. It has a strong element of mutually supportive relatioship, and it helps Sora is really cute throughout the route.

entry.title: Reading: Atomic Habits
entry.content:
Background

I was reading the book Atomic Habits and I was reading the first few pages. I found what was said to be insightful, in determining what I want to be instead of the end goal. I find that usually when my parents ask me to clean my room usually it get messy again soon enough. Reading this made me realize that it is purely because the habits do not substain the goal. So I wish to reflect on this. Starting with the below

What type of person do I want to be?

This question is suprising difficult to answer, despite being a seemingly easy question. I broke it down into the following questions to answer instead.

What am I doing NOW

-Going to internship

-Preparing for University

-Play video games

-Running my Toastmaster Club

-Helping my community network in tech areas

-Mindlessly browsing and listening to Music

-Cleaning up my room

What will I CONTINUE doing/STOP doing?

What I want to do now What I will stop doing

|————————————-|——————————-|

Studying OSINT/tech related things Going to University

I was a little suprise to see that I listed both studying and University. I listed the two and I think I see the issue

Aspect University Education Self Study (OSINT/tech)

|———————-|————————————————|———————————————-|

Pace Fixed, often rushed Self‑paced, can slow down to understand
Teaching style Professors focused on research, not teaching Self‑selected resources, learn by doing
Motivation Studying for tests, external pressure Internal curiosity, goals I set myself
Goal setting Curriculum‑driven, rigid I set the study goals and path
Schedule control Fixed class times, attendance requirements I decide when, how long, and the rhythm
Autonomy over content Core subjects, prerequisites, limited choice I choose exactly what I want, in any order
Evaluation pressure Grades, exams, GPA, bell curve Self‑assessment, pulbic perception
Hierarchy Professors as authority, power distance Bad resources get discarded
Intellectual freedom Curriculum decides what’s relevant I get to chase after useless knowledge

I did not realize these restriction until I head to University Charles III of Madrid for an exchange semester, where the way lessosn are conducted there affected my thoughts. The key difference is the the professors are more open to questions and meeting with students, as well as more intellectual freedom to explore topics we are interested in(even if my group squandered it). I think this is why it is more toleratable even through it is signficantly more difficult. I want to solve the ‘how’ and not go through a rigid process.

Based on this, here is my first identity: I want to be a student of technology.

What I want to do now What I will stop doing

|————————————-|——————————-|

Travel overseas Mindlessly Browse the web
Do things with intent Lose time to Listening to Music
Finish reading my bookshelf Stop buying more books
Help uplift the community Eat unhealth sugarly drinks
Go for Health Checkup  

These are group together because they have a common theme, which is active vs passive consumption. The left side are about doing and experiencing things, while most of the thing I want to stop are passive consumptions. For things on the left I felt that they are usually harder to start, however upon starting it is harder to stop. Whereas things on the right are easy to start and easy to stay engaged, but at the end I felt that I haven’t done anything.

So the second Identity will be: I want to be someone who does and experience.
